text:
Fushimi Inari never closes and costs nothing to enter, and the first JR train from Kyoto Station leaves at 5:33 on weekdays. That's how you get those famous red gates almost to yourself 👇

🤔 Dawn, afternoon or after dark? Make your pick, then see ours 👉 https://japanbystation.com/fushimi-inari-dawn-day-or-after-dark

We took our time with this one and checked the train times, sunrise and opening hours against official sources, because "go early" means nothing without the numbers.

⛩️ THE THREE ANSWERS

🌅 Dawn. Sunrise in Kyoto is about 6:40 in late November and about 7:05 at the end of December. Walk the Senbon Torii in blue light, then climb to Yotsutsuji, about 30 to 45 minutes up, for the view over southern Kyoto.

☀️ Afternoon. Guides put the busy stretch at roughly 9:00 to 18:00, and the jam is at the bottom. It only works if you're willing to keep climbing, because the crowd thins the higher you go.

🌙 After dark. The lower areas are lit and the mood is magical, but most of the mountain loop has no lights, and guides mention monkeys and wild boar in the woods. Lower gates yes, full climb no.

🦊 OUR TAKE

Dawn, up to Yotsutsuji and back, about two hours with photo stops. Then breakfast at the gate: Inafuku opens at 9:00 for inari sushi and udon (closed Tuesdays, cash or PayPay).

👉 The "echo pond" halfway up and the old custom behind it, plus the full dawn route with times:
